I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes, and I've sent Dana the list in her DM thread.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. Moss also noted the kiosk logs should be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea also logged this one. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, and it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't say when this happened.

I checked all six of Moss's notes that Dana can see: four North digests and two Central digests. Two other North digests (14 Sep 2025 and 23 Mar 2026) mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers. The tickets in the Central digests (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to Central accounts, not this one. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways," which is a different company and not a customer.
